component.name: PhlixApp
component.interface:
' Deep-link params from cold-launch: { contentId, mediaType, action } ' Set by main.brs when valid deep-link args are present in launch params.
' Exit signal (M-ROKU-01): set by OnKeyEvent when Back is pressed with an ' empty screen stack (we are on a bootstrap scene). Observed by main.brs on ' the screen message port; the loop then returns, ending the channel cleanly. ' There is no creatable roApp.Exit() primitive in Roku SceneGraph (absent from ' the official component library bsc ships), so main-thread exit-by-return is ' the platform-correct cure. Scripts must never fall through to RSG's native ' back handling: it closes only the FOCUSED scene, exposing the root's black ' boot chrome as a dead screen (review roku__casualgamer M2).
' Toast dispatch channel (M-ROKU-17 r2, review roku__gameux M17r1 ' CRITICAL-1): the root scene's observed interface fields are the ' delivery wire. Producers (source/lib/ToastManager.brs, running in ' any consumer scope) walk the GetParent chain to this root, write ' the String/Integer payload, then bump the alwaysNotify toastSeq ' trigger; PhlixApp Init wires ObserveField("toastSeq", ' "OnToastNotice") — the repo's proven render-thread idiom ' (requestClose arms, ShowErrorDialog's wasClosed observers). This ' replaces the retired node.PostMessage -> onMessage fiction: ' roSGNode has no documented onMessage receive contract (bsc models ' PostMessage only on roRenderThreadQueue, whose receive path is ' AddMessageHandler — used nowhere in this channel). Payload fields ' need no alwaysNotify; only the trigger does. CHECK49 R7 pins the ' trio. Zero user-facing literals (CHECK25 intact — copy reaches the ' render path only as app-side static Strings, ROKU-12/CHECK43).
